facts.text: Sunset Tower Hotel sits on the Sunset Strip in West Hollywood.
facts.excerpt: On the heart of the Sunset Strip in West Hollywood, Sunset Tower Hotel offers luxurious accommodations

facts.text: The hotel's 15-floor Art Deco tower first opened as an apartment building in 1929.
facts.excerpt: The 15-floor Art Deco tower first opened as an apartment building in 1929

facts.text: Former residents of the tower include Howard Hughes, John Wayne, Marilyn Monroe, Elizabeth Taylor and Frank Sinatra.
facts.excerpt: former residents include Howard Hughes, John Wayne, Marilyn Monroe, Elizabeth Taylor, and Frank Sinatra

facts.text: In 2004, New York-based hotelier and restaurateur Jeff Klein bought and transformed what had become a run-down hotel.
facts.excerpt: In 2004, New York-based hotelier and restaurateur Jeff Klein bought and transformed what had become a run-down hotel

facts.text: Rooms and suites have custom furnishings and floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows.
facts.excerpt: Our spacious and airy rooms & suites offer custom furnishings and floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows

facts.text: Some rooms and suites have deep soaking limestone baths and separate living spaces.
facts.excerpt: some with deep soaking limestone baths and separate living spaces

facts.text: An elegant palette of neutrals, rosewood and brass gives the rooms an Old World feel.
facts.excerpt: An elegant palette of neutrals, rosewood, and brass give the rooms an Old World feel.

facts.text: Townhouse Suites are split-level apartments with 20-foot-high ceilings.
facts.excerpt: Our Townhouse Suites are grand, split-level apartments with 20-foot-high ceilings

facts.text: Townhouse Suites have outdoor terraces with sweeping views of Los Angeles to the south.
facts.excerpt: outdoor terraces with sweeping views of Los Angeles to the south

facts.text: Townhouse Suites must be booked directly with the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Townhouse Suites must be booked directly with the hotel.

facts.text: Penthouse Suites have wraparound terraces with sweeping views of the Hollywood Hills and downtown Los Angeles.
facts.excerpt: wraparound terraces offering sweeping views of the Hollywood Hills and downtown Los Angeles

facts.text: Turndown brings warm, fresh-baked chocolate chip cookies.
facts.excerpt: Warm, fresh-baked chocolate chip cookies at turndown are reason enough to hole up come evening.

facts.text: All accommodations get twice daily housekeeping service, including turndown.
facts.excerpt: Twice daily housekeeping service, including turndown

facts.text: The pool has sweeping views of the city as a backdrop.
facts.excerpt: The pool at Sunset Tower Hotel is tranquil and relaxed, with sweeping views of the city as a backdrop

facts.text: The pool sits on an elevated terrace, with views that stretch to Santa Monica and downtown.
facts.excerpt: a dreamy pool in an elevated terrace and sweeping views that stretch to Santa Monica and downtown

facts.text: The pool is reserved for registered hotel guests only.
facts.excerpt: Reserved for registered hotel guests only.

facts.text: The pool has a strict no unaccompanied minors policy.
facts.excerpt: Please note the pool at Sunset Tower has a strict “No Unaccompanied Minors” policy.

facts.text: The fitness center includes a Pvolve low-impact fitness training platform.
facts.excerpt: Pvolve low-impact fitness training platform

facts.text: Sunset Tower is very pet friendly.
facts.excerpt: Sunset Tower is very pet friendly.

facts.text: Pets get mini Sunset Tower beds, bowls and treats.
facts.excerpt: pets with mini Sunset Tower beds, bowls, and treats

facts.text: William S. Hart Park, where dogs can run unleashed, adjoins the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Adjoining the hotel is William S. Hart Park (bequeathed by the silent film actor), a haven for dogs to run around unleashed.

facts.text: There is a $100 non-refundable pet fee.
facts.excerpt: Please note there is a $100 non-refundable pet fee.

facts.text: The hotel charges a nightly amenity fee of $52.43, inclusive of tax.
facts.excerpt: The nightly Amenity Fee of $52.43, inclusive of tax, includes:

facts.text: Valet parking costs $75 nightly, and oversized vehicles may incur a higher fee.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking, $75 nightly, oversized vehicles may incur higher fee

facts.text: The gift boutique carries books and Hollywood memorabilia.
facts.excerpt: Peruse a unique collection of books and Hollywood memorabilia.

facts.text: The Tower Bar is housed in Bugsy Siegel's former apartment on the ground floor.
facts.excerpt: Housed in Bugsy Siegel's former apartment on the ground floor, The Tower Bar

facts.text: At the Tower Bar, guests sip cocktails to the playing of jazz pianists.
facts.excerpt: Here guests can sip cocktails in flattering rose-colored light, lulled by the playing of famed jazz pianists.

facts.text: At the Tower Bar and Restaurant, shorts, baseball caps, sweats, sandals, tank tops, phone calls, computers and photos are not permitted.
facts.excerpt: Shorts, baseball caps, sweats, sandals, tank tops, phone calls, computers and photos are not permitted.

facts.text: The outdoor Terrace has a covered travertine lanai with a view of the swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: a covered travertine lanai with a view of the swimming pool

facts.text: Accommodations include a complimentary minibar with snacks and alcohol.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary Mini Bar with snacks and alcohol

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler readers named Sunset Tower Hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards in 2020, 2021, 2024 and 2026.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2020, 2021, 2024, 2026

facts.text: The New York Times called it Hollywood's Grand Dame Hotel.
facts.excerpt: Hollywood's Grand Dame Hotel

facts.text: The minibar is replenished every 3 days.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary Mini Bar with snacks &  alcoholic beverages, replenished every 3 days.

facts.text: The minibar is replenished every two days.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary mini bar (replenished every two (2) days)
